newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Soquimich signs $200 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Soquimich signs $200 mln loan.

text.p: Chilean fertilizer maker Sociedad Quimica y Minera de Chile SA (Soquimich) said on Monday it received a $200 million loan from the Union Bank of Switzerland to finance investment projects.
The loan is at a rate of interest of 7.7 percent with interest payments to be made every six months from March 15 1997, said Soquimich in a statement to the Securities Superintendency.
There will be a single capital payment on September 15 2006, it said.
The company did not give details of projects that the loan would be used to finance.
Soquimich officials have said the firm will invest $500 million in 1996-7 in expanding its fertilizer and iodine operations and in the new Minsal nitrate mine.
Projects include boosting iodine production from 5,000 tonnes a year to 8,000 tonnes by 1997, they said.
